chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.text:
This policy defines the conditions under which customers may request a return, replacement, or
refund for products purchased from ABC Retail.

chunks.title: Refund Eligibility
chunks.text:
Customers may request a refund within 30 calendar days from the delivery date. To qualify:
• The item must be unused and in its original condition.
• Original packaging, accessories, manuals, and labels must be included.
• A valid invoice or proof of purchase is required.
• The order must not be marked as 'Final Sale'.

chunks.title: Non-Refundable Items
chunks.text:
Refunds are not available for:
• Digital products after activation or download.
• Gift cards or store credits.
• Personalized or custom-made products.
• Hygiene products after opening.
• Products damaged due to misuse, negligence, or unauthorized repair.

chunks.title: Damaged or Incorrect Deliveries
chunks.text:
If an item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect:
• Report the issue within 7 days of delivery.
• Provide photographs of the product and packaging.
• Customers may choose a replacement or full refund after verification.

chunks.title: Return Shipping
chunks.text:
• Customers are responsible for return shipping unless the return is due to our error.
• Shipping fees are refundable only when the wrong or defective product was delivered.

chunks.title: Refund Processing
chunks.text:
• Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days.
• Credit card refunds may take an additional 3–10 business days depending on the bank.
• Original shipping charges are not refunded unless required by this policy.

chunks.title: Partial Refunds
chunks.text:
Partial refunds may be issued when:
• The product is returned with minor missing accessories.
• The item shows light customer-induced wear.
• The returned quantity is less than the purchased quantity.

chunks.title: Exchange Policy
chunks.text:
Customers may request an exchange instead of a refund if identical stock is available.
Exchanges follow the same eligibility rules as refunds.

chunks.title: Special Business Rules
chunks.text:
• Orders older than 30 days are automatically rejected.
• Premium members receive priority processing.
• Orders above $2,000 require manager approval before refund.
• Bulk or corporate purchases are reviewed individually.
• Fraudulent refund requests may result in account suspension.
